import inspect
from solution import check_Equality


def test_issue_example_abcda():
    """Example: check_Equality("abcda") == "Equal"."""
    assert check_Equality("abcda") == "Equal"  # 'a' == 'a' so "Equal"


def test_issue_single_char_equal():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("z") == "Equal"  # 'z' == 'z' so "Equal"


def test_issue_two_same_chars_equal():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("mm") == "Equal"  # 'm' == 'm' so "Equal"


def test_issue_longer_equal_ends():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("xyzyx") == "Equal"  # 'x' == 'x' so "Equal"


def test_issue_numeric_equal_ends():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("1abc1") == "Equal"  # '1' == '1' so "Equal"


def test_issue_different_ends_not_equal():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("abcde") != "Equal"  # 'a' != 'e' so not "Equal"


def test_issue_two_different_chars_not_equal():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("ab") != "Equal"  # 'a' != 'b' so not "Equal"


def test_issue_case_sensitive_not_equal():
    """Check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not."""
    assert check_Equality("Abca") != "Equal"  # 'A' != 'a' so not "Equal"


def test_contract_returns_string_on_equal():
    """Example return "Equal" is a string."""
    assert isinstance(check_Equality("abcda"), str) is True  # type("Equal") is str so True


def test_contract_returns_string_on_unequal():
    """Check whether first and last characters are equal or not returns a string."""
    assert isinstance(check_Equality("abcde"), str) is True  # 'a' != 'e' still str so True


def test_contract_takes_one_argument():
    """Implement check_Equality(str) in solution.py."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(check_Equality).parameters) == 1  # 1 param: str
